author: I_cy
body: Hello my username is Icy_Farts and I was banned for ban evasion. This was because I went onto my cousins computer and logged on to my account. After that my cousin started hacking on avicus so somebody thought I was the alt when I was not. Sorry for the misunderstanding can I please be unbanned.

replies.body:
I was notified that you joined the server yet again and started playing. Which you can probably can confirm, since you got banned again. Would you like to explain me why you joined the server again while knowing that you are currently permanently banned?

The ipcheck displays all accounts that share the ip of another account. In this case it shows the accounts of your "cousins" and your "brother", because they have/had the same ip as Icy_Farts.
